policy.main: v21 immutable N9691; mean with repeated records; angular K-Means/Ward; J300 demand DESC prefix ASC
policy.coverage: nearest represented postal center; distance <= R; covered integer orders >= ceil(.95*N)
policy.quantiles: empirical inverse CDF over order counts, ceil(q*N), no interpolation
policy.search: every integer K from 1; first simultaneous five-seed feasible K; no monotonicity assumption
policy.geography: administrative municipal union; no water, terrain or commercial validity claim
policy.redistribution: hypothesis only: equal fractional order weight among retained records of each prefix; not individual addresses
policy.omissions: D16 strict record majority; D22 includes six ties; exploratory not validated recovery
policy.comparison: overlapping K intervals imply absence of robust descriptive separation, not statistical equivalence
policy.pmedian: same greedy construction, candidate order, first-improvement swaps, eps1e-9, max_iter100
policy.timing: descriptive wall clock, excludes metrics/export; cached fit time retained; not a controlled CPU comparison

frozen_protocol: Protocol freeze before implementation; not independent prospective preregistration
private_raw_data: Inputs read-only; no download or raw-data modification

geometry_source.source: IBGE API de malhas geograficas v3, qualidade maxima

reference_year_verification.comparison: Byte-identical to the existing versioned GeoJSON; all 92 municipal features also match topologically

geometry_source.review_policy: Every valid-coordinate row outside the inclusive study polygon requires an explicit recorded decision; no percentile or distance-to-facility exclusion rule.
